faces.name: Eye of Singularity
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, destroy each permanent with the same name as another permanent, except for basic lands. They can't be regenerated.
Whenever a permanent other than a basic land enters, destroy all other permanents with that name. They can't be regenerated.

faces.name: Eye of the Storm
faces.oracleText: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery card, exile it. Then that player copies each instant or sorcery card exiled with this enchantment. For each copy, the player may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Eye of Ugin
faces.oracleText:
Colorless Eldrazi spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.
{7}, {T}: Search your library for a colorless creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

faces.name: Eye of Vecna
faces.oracleText:
When Eye of Vecna enters, you draw a card and you lose 2 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {2}. If you do, you draw a card and you lose 2 life.

faces.name: Eye of Yawgmoth
faces.oracleText: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Reveal a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the sacrificed creature's power. Put one into your hand and exile the rest.
